requirements.title: Machine-readable conformance evidence gates
Executable token transitions for an explicitly admitted BPMN subset
requirements.notes: The executable subset includes Standard Loops and FixedMultiInstance/1 on generic Tasks. FixedMultiInstance/1 evaluates one cardinality expression at activation, freezes a bounded non-negative member set, runs it sequentially or in parallel with stable item identity, and either joins all members or terminates the remainder when a completionCondition first becomes true. Collection data mapping, SubProcess and CallActivity multi-instance execution, progressive behavior events, output collections, and open or draining groups remain outside this kernel subset.

requirements.title: FixedMultiInstance/1 bounded generic Task execution
requirements.notes: This atomic executable profile is restricted to one generic Task with a version-bound formal loopCardinality, behavior absent or All, sequential or parallel execution, an optional version-bound formal completionCondition, and a compiled maximum cardinality. Cardinality is evaluated once before member creation. Durable group/member state records stable index and item identity, exact active/completed/terminated counters, first-true completion cancellation, Boundary Error or failure cleanup, late-completion fencing, and causal journal replay. XML v4 can represent collection references and One/None/Complex behavior metadata, but this executable profile rejects those broader forms. It does not claim collection input/output mapping, SubProcess or CallActivity multi-instance execution, progressive behavior events, output aggregation, open WCP15 groups, draining WCP34/WCP36 joins, or a complete BPMN Activity lifecycle.

requirements.title: Protocol-bound Task outcomes and interrupting Boundary Error execution slice
requirements.notes: This atomic slice admits an immutable protocol-v3 binding on a generic Task, one-execution translation from a native managed-retry result, exact application-failure-to-BPMN-Error promotion, and at most one interrupting Boundary Error. The XML executable facade accepts task bindings explicitly through CompileXmlOptions and commits them to the executable fingerprint; bindings remain external executable inputs and are not inferred from BPMN XML. Schedule-to-close timeout remains operational and is not treated as a BPMN Error or Boundary Timer. This is not evidence for the complete Activity lifecycle, generic event propagation, BPMN Cancel, timers, non-interrupting boundaries, or event subprocesses.

requirements.title: Executable intersection of the named core-process XML profile and token kernel
requirements.notes: This is a deliberately narrower executable admission profile, not Process Execution Conformance. Profile bpmn-2.0.2-core-process-di-v4 admits while-style pre-test and BPMN post-tested Standard Loops plus FixedMultiInstance/1 only on generic Tasks. FixedMultiInstance/1 requires a version-bound loopCardinality, freezes it at activation under a compiled cap, supports sequential or parallel behavior All, and optionally evaluates a version-bound completionCondition after each committed member completion. It rejects rather than infers unsupported process, gateway, event, activity, combined-loop, SubProcess-loop, collection-mapping, progressive behavior, open-group, and implicit-activation semantics.

source.section: tDefinitions, tProcess, tActivity, tStandardLoopCharacteristics, tMultiInstanceLoopCharacteristics, flow nodes, and tSequenceFlow

requirements.notes: Profile bpmn-2.0.2-core-process-di-v4 covers ordinary processes and recursive subprocesses, generic tasks, source-level callActivity callable-element QNames, none start/end events, exclusive/parallel gateways, sequence flows, conditions, defaults, definitions metadata, explicit expression-version bindings, Standard Loop characteristics, and the represented tMultiInstanceLoopCharacteristics fields on generic Tasks. Multi-instance XML can round-trip cardinality, collection references, sequential/parallel mode, completionCondition, behavior, and One/None event references in BPMN schema order; inputDataItem, outputDataItem, and complexBehaviorDefinition remain outside the normalized XML slice. The executable FixedMultiInstance/1 intersection is deliberately narrower: cardinality only, behavior All, no collection mapping, and generic Tasks only. Call activities are interchange-only until immutable child-target resolution and durable parent/child execution exist. This is a fail-closed implementation slice, not an OMG conformance subclass, complete semantic mapping, or general multi-instance profile.

requirements.title: WCP1 Sequence
WCP2 Parallel Split
WCP3 Synchronization
WCP4 Exclusive Choice
WCP13 Multiple Instances with a Priori Design-Time Knowledge - fixed Task subset
requirements.notes: FixedMultiInstance/1 covers the design-time-known case when the pinned cardinality expression represents a fixed model value: parallel mode creates the closed set of independent, stably identified members and produces one continuation only after every member has completed. Sequential mode is supported by the BPMN profile but is not used as evidence for the pattern's concurrent form. The same runtime primitive also admits WCP14 when the expression obtains its value from activation data.

requirements.title: WCP14 Multiple Instances with a Priori Run-Time Knowledge - frozen Task subset
requirements.notes: FixedMultiInstance/1 evaluates one runtime cardinality before creating any member, freezes the closed member set under a compiled cap, and joins all members before one continuation. Parallel mode is the WCP14 evidence; sequential mode is an additional BPMN execution form. It does not admit new members after activation and therefore does not claim WCP15.

requirements.title: WCP35 Cancelling Partial Join for Multiple Instances - completionCondition subset
requirements.notes: The admitted subset evaluates a pinned BPMN completionCondition after every committed logical member completion. The first true result produces one continuation and terminates every remaining active or pending member; late completion is fenced and idempotent. The group is closed before member creation, so this does not claim WCP15 open creation, WCP34 remainder draining, or WCP36 dynamic creation/draining. Those require a separate OpenForEachGroup/1 profile.

requirements.title: WCP21 Structured Loop - bounded generic Task subset
requirements.notes: This atomic requirement is scoped to executable while-style pre-test and BPMN post-tested behavior for one generic Task, with durable iteration identity, exact condition evidence whose true result means continue, and a mandatory positive iteration cap. It does not claim WCP21's combined pre/post-test variant, Standard Loops on SubProcesses, arbitrary cycles, or any multi-instance pattern. BPMN 2.0.2 section 13.3.6 explicitly maps Structured Loop to WCP-21; section 10.3.8 and Table 10.28 define the Standard Loop condition, testBefore default, and loopMaximum cap.
